behavior: Only nondeferred, nonempty-target Activate copies at the before hook; a later Activate error does not undo copied file.
File-branch source/admission failure returns error; filesystem effects and target-directory creation are independent of DB rollback; erroring OS copy may leave partial target effects.
Clean preserves KeepOnUninstall targets and protected directories; unprotected single file is removed when keep is false.
Transport success plus 2xx or 401 with WWW-Authenticate means registry available; 401 without challenge and403 do not. Availability is distinct from authorization/pull success.
Full file export precedes summary format validation; completed JSON file can remain despite an unknown summary format error; valid summary format succeeds.
Name lookup has precedence, ExternalName is fallback; missing both yields error and inspection preserves installed record identity/version.
